description: This source file defines a comparer class for table cells used within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Visitors namespace. The CellComparer class implements comparison logic for cells based on their position in a table (row and column indices).

classes.name: CellComparer
classes.description: A comparer class for table cells that compares cells based on their row and column positions.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two Cell objects based on their position in the table (row and column indices).
